solutions.title: Recursive preorder codec
solutions.strategy: Emit value/null markers in preorder and consume the token stream recursively during decode.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node and null marker is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The token stream and recursion stack are linear in the tree size.

solutions.title: Iterative preorder codec
solutions.strategy: Produce the same preorder format iteratively and decode with an index holder to avoid substring parsing.

timeComplexity.explanation: Serialization and deserialization both traverse the token list once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The token list and stack/index state are linear.
